name: markdown-exactness-unresolved
body: The markdown frontend must preserve the exactness posture of the code frontends: an edge is emitted only where a link or a containment resolves to a project node. A link that cannot be resolved yields an UnresolvedTarget with a category, never a fabricated FQN, exactly as never-fabricate-edges and exactness-no-heuristic require; there is no heuristic link resolution and no provenance/confidence tier. The markdown frontend is bound by the same frontend contract as every code frontend (global.constraint.frontend-full-context, requirements.requirement.full-context-targeted-emission), and markdown is not exempt from it: link resolution always runs against the FULL document set — every scanned markdown document, not merely the emitted target — so under incremental emission (win B) a re-emitted .md whose links point at unchanged documents still resolves against the full context; only emission is filtered to the target set. AC: the broken-link fixture produces only unresolved_use edges to UnresolvedTargets and no guessed uses edge; and under incremental emission a re-scanned .md whose cross-file link targets an unchanged, un-emitted document still yields the resolved Uses edge rather than an UnresolvedUse.
